name: codeprism
description: Pack your codebase into a single AI-ready Markdown file: gitignore-aware, binary-asset friendly, deterministic. 100% local packing; the extension itself makes no network calls.

commands.title: CodePrism: Pack Entire Workspace to Markdown
CodePrism: Copy Selected as Markdown to Clipboard

codeprism.outputFileName.markdownDescription: Name of the generated Markdown file. It is written to the workspace folder root (or the common parent directory of the selection when no folder is open).

codeprism.copyToClipboardAfterGenerate.description: Also copy the generated Markdown to the system clipboard after writing the file.

codeprism.additionalIgnorePatterns.markdownDescription: Extra gitignore-style patterns to exclude, e.g. `["*.log", "docs/**"]`. Applied in addition to `.gitignore` rules and built-in defaults; these explicit patterns take precedence over `.gitignore` negations (`!pattern`).

codeprism.ignoreLockFiles.description: Ignore dependency lock files (package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, Cargo.lock, poetry.lock, go.sum, ...).

codeprism.truncateContentPatterns.markdownDescription: Extra gitignore-style patterns whose content is preview-truncated (in addition to the built-in `LICENSE`/`COPYING` list). Matched files stay in the file tree; only the first `#codeprism.truncatedPreviewChars#` characters are rendered, followed by a truncation notice.

codeprism.truncatedPreviewChars.description: Characters kept for truncated files (LICENSE-like). 0 omits their content entirely, keeping only the truncation notice.

codeprism.maxFileBytes.description: Text files larger than this (bytes) are never read in full; only a leading preview of truncatedPreviewChars characters is included. 0 disables the limit.

codeprism.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Path to a Python 3.10+ interpreter: a plain executable path, without arguments or shell syntax. Leave empty to auto-detect: the active environment of the Microsoft Python extension (if installed), then `python3` / `python` on PATH.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run sync:core && npm run vendor && npm run build
scripts.test:integration: npm run sync:core && npm run vendor && npm run check && npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node out-test/test/runTest.js
